tools.name: find_nepa_section
tools.description: Find the DiscoverNEPA section that covers a topic — things to do, dining, lodging, outdoors, trails, parks, or living in the region. Returns a working URL.

topic.description: Topic or interest, e.g. "hiking", "restaurants", "moving here". Leave empty to list all sections.

tools.name: get_nepa_agent_resources
tools.description: List the machine-readable agent-discovery resources published by discovernepa.com.

tools.name: get_nepa_events_guidance
tools.description: Return the DiscoverNEPA events pages and the rules for handling dated and recurring events, so a finished event is never reported as upcoming.
